headline: Exelon (EXC) Time Of Day Pricing Launch Puts Valuation Back In Focus
summary: Exelon (EXC) is drawing fresh attention after its Illinois utility, ComEd, launched a Time-of-Day Pricing program and as investors look ahead to the company’s upcoming quarterly earnings report later this month. See our latest analysis for Exelon. At a share price of $47.28, Exelon has seen positive short term momentum with a 1 day share price return of 1.24% and a 7 day share price return of 2.20%.
